baselines.B1_OTHER_RUN_HARD_MAJORITY: class 1 iff leave-target-run KEEP vote fraction >= 0.5
baselines.B2_ALL_RUN_HARD_MAJORITY: class 1 iff all-run KEEP vote fraction >= 0.5; exact tie deterministically maps to class 1
baselines.B3_OTHER_RUN_PROBABILITY_MEAN: class 1 iff leave-target-run mean KEEP p(y=1) >= 0.5
baselines.B4_ALL_RUN_PROBABILITY_MEAN: class 1 iff all-run mean KEEP p(y=1) >= 0.5
baselines.B5_OTHER_RUN_LOGIT_MEAN: class 1 iff leave-target-run mean centered KEEP margin >= 0
baselines.B6_ALL_RUN_LOGIT_MEAN: class 1 iff all-run mean centered KEEP margin >= 0
baselines.B7_CONFIDENCE_WEIGHTED_KEEP_ENSEMBLE: all-run p(y=1) mean weighted by max(abs(p-0.5),1e-12), threshold 0.5

controls.C1_GATED_DIRECT_CONSENSUS: replace target prediction with other-run hard majority on disagreement
controls.C2_ACTION_MASKED_DIRECT_CONSENSUS_FULL: same availability mask as frozen FULL; directly emit other-run majority
controls.C3_ACTION_MASKED_DIRECT_CONSENSUS_SAFE: same AMPLIFY+GEOMETRY mask as frozen SAFE; directly emit other-run majority

best_ensemble_selection.criterion: largest mean subject-balanced Delta BA versus B0 among B1-B7
